response.courseDescription: 369 Queer Identities in Contemporary Cultures Analysis of roots/legacies of creative resistance writing by Queer communities of color; students learn to produce creative resistance work. (Crosslisted course offered as WGSS 369, HISTORY 369.)
response.coursePrerequisites: CES 101, HISTORY 105, HISTORY 305, WGSS 101, or WGSS 120.
